heading: The full service lifecycle.
lead: Every engagement follows the same five stages. You always know where your building sits.

services.title: Preventive maintenance
services.problem: Filters, coils, and pressures drift out of spec between visits.
services.solution: Scheduled inspections, cleaning, and measured checks against the manufacturer's limits.
services.outcome: Fewer breakdowns and a documented service history.

services.title: Emergency repair
services.problem: A fault stops cooling in one zone or across the whole building.
services.solution: Diagnosis, isolation, and repair with parts sourced for your equipment.
services.outcome: Comfort restored and the root cause written into your report.

services.title: Installation
services.problem: New equipment is only as good as its commissioning.
services.solution: Load review, pipework and controls checks, then commissioning to design values.
services.outcome: A system that runs to specification from day one.

services.title: Retrofit
services.problem: Aging systems no longer meet occupancy or efficiency needs.
services.solution: Phased replacement and controls upgrades planned around building use.
services.outcome: Lower running costs without closing the building.
